spike: SPIKE 7 — RFC 9728 protected-resource metadata path + proving DCR is off (better-auth MCP plugin)
claim: The better-auth `mcp` plugin serves RFC 9728 protected-resource metadata at a path MCPRouter can use, and DCR can be proven off. Corollary in spec §14: MCPRouter must mount its OWN wildcard route for the path-inserted form `/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mcp` because better-auth "is unlikely to know about /mcp".
verdict: CONFIRMED (claim) — but the corollary is REFUTED: the plugin serves the path-inserted form itself, and the plugin is not in better-auth core, it is a separate package `@better-auth/mcp@1.7.5`.

1. `/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-nguyenhanh-orca-projects-MCPRouter/4911361f-32f3-47c8-97c7-182f1fc87bd2/scratchpad/spikes/spike-7-prm-dcr.mjs` — `node spike-7-prm-dcr.mjs`. Real Hono + @hono/node-server on :4711, `app.all("/api/auth/*", h)` + `app.all("/.well-known/*", h)` + a `app.all("*")` that returns `hono-404-not-routed-to-better-auth`, so "did better-auth answer?" vs "did Hono never route it?" are distinguishable. Probes all 7 requested paths with real `fetch`.
2. `/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-nguyenhanh-orca-projects-MCPRouter/4911361f-32f3-47c8-97c7-182f1fc87bd2/scratchpad/spikes/spike-7b-dcr-toggle.mjs` — `node spike-7b-dcr-toggle.mjs`. Three servers (:4712 defaults, :4713 `allowDynamicClientRegistration:true` as a negative control, :4714 `basePath:"/"`), each with `app.all("*")` so nothing is hidden by routing.

Setup notes (exactly what I did): the pinned install does NOT contain the mcp plugin, so I ran `npm install @better-auth/mcp@1.7.5` (pulled `@better-auth/oauth-provider@1.7.5` transitively; 2 packages). No database server was needed — `memoryAdapter` from `better-auth/adapters/memory` works, but it throws `Error: Model oauthResource not found` on an empty `{}`, so I passed `memoryAdapter(new Proxy({}, { get: (t, k) => (t[k] ??= []) }))` to auto-vivify tables. Config: `betterAuth({ baseURL: "http://localhost:PORT", secret, database, plugins: [jwt(), mcp({ loginPage, consentPage, resource: "http://localhost:PORT/mcp" })] })`.

evidence:
PLUGIN IS NOT IN CORE:
- /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-nguyenhanh-orca-projects-MCPRouter/4911361f-32f3-47c8-97c7-182f1fc87bd2/scratchpad/spikes/node_modules/better-auth/dist/plugins/index.mjs:49 — the single `export {...}` line of `better-auth/plugins` lists admin, anonymous, bearer, captcha, ..., twoFactor, username. No `mcp`, no `oidcProvider`, no `oauthProvider`. `grep -rl "oauth-protected-resource" node_modules/` matches only `@modelcontextprotocol/sdk`, never `better-auth`. npm registry: `@better-auth/mcp@1.7.5` "Model Context Protocol (MCP) plugin for Better Auth".

PRM SERVED AT BOTH FORMS (this is the refutation of the wildcard corollary):
- .../node_modules/@better-auth/mcp/dist/index.mjs:88 — `const PROTECTED_RESOURCE_METADATA_PATH = "/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource";`
- .../node_modules/@better-auth/mcp/dist/index.mjs:188 — `resourcePath = new URL(resource).pathname.replace(/\/$/, "")`
- .../node_modules/@better-auth/mcp/dist/index.mjs:192 — `if (!new Set([PROTECTED_RESOURCE_METADATA_PATH, `${PROTECTED_RESOURCE_METADATA_PATH}${resourcePath}`]).has(requestPath)) return;` — i.e. root form AND path-inserted form, derived from the configured `resource`.
- .../node_modules/@better-auth/mcp/dist/index.mjs:193-196 — non-GET/HEAD => 405 `Allow: GET, HEAD`; :198-201 HEAD => empty body, same headers.
- .../node_modules/@better-auth/mcp/dist/index.mjs:111-124 — `buildResourceServerMetadata`: `resource`, `authorization_servers:[getIssuer(...)]`, `bearer_methods_supported:["header"]`, `dpop_signing_alg_values_supported`, optional `scopes_supported` / `dpop_bound_access_tokens_required`.
- .../node_modules/@better-auth/mcp/dist/index.mjs:14-27 — `validateMcpResource`: absolute URL, no credentials, no `#`, no `?`, https-only except localhost/loopback. Throws at `betterAuth()` construction.

DCR DEFAULTS OFF:
- .../node_modules/@better-auth/oauth-provider/dist/authorize-riRRCSbC.mjs:4206-4207 — `allowUnauthenticatedClientRegistration: false, allowDynamicClientRegistration: false` (the defaults object).
- .../node_modules/@better-auth/oauth-provider/dist/authorize-riRRCSbC.mjs:696 — `registration_endpoint: overrides?.dynamic_client_registration_supported ? `${baseURL}/oauth2/register` : void 0` — key is omitted entirely when off.
- .../node_modules/@better-auth/oauth-provider/dist/authorize-riRRCSbC.mjs:746 — `dynamic_client_registration_supported: opts.allowDynamicClientRegistration`.
- .../node_modules/@better-auth/oauth-provider/dist/authorize-riRRCSbC.mjs:1722 — `if (!opts.allowDynamicClientRegistration) throw new APIError("FORBIDDEN", ...)`; :1729 — second gate requiring a session unless `allowUnauthenticatedClientRegistration`.
- .../node_modules/@better-auth/oauth-provider/dist/authorize-riRRCSbC.mjs:5063 — `registerOAuthClient: createOAuthEndpoint("/oauth2/register", ...)` — the DCR path is `<basePath>/oauth2/register`, never `/mcp/register`.

AS METADATA PATHS:
- .../node_modules/@better-auth/oauth-provider/dist/authorize-riRRCSbC.mjs:4237 — `const authServerMetadataPaths = new Set([`/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server${issuerPath}`, `${issuerPath}/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server`]);` — issuerPath is the issuer URL's pathname, so with the default basePath the bare root form is NOT served.
- .../node_modules/@better-auth/oauth-provider/dist/authorize-riRRCSbC.mjs:5364-5372 — `getIssuer` = `jwt` plugin's `options.jwt.issuer ?? ctx.context.baseURL` — the one knob that moves the issuer (and hence every discovery path).

CLIENT SIDE (what MCP clients actually probe):
- .../node_modules/@modelcontextprotocol/sdk/dist/esm/client/auth.js:470 — `buildWellKnownPath` = `/.well-known/${prefix}${pathname}` (or prepended form).
- .../node_modules/@modelcontextprotocol/sdk/dist/esm/client/auth.js:499-507 — PRM: try path-inserted first, fall back to the root `/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource`. Both are 200 above.
- .../node_modules/@modelcontextprotocol/sdk/dist/esm/client/auth.js:552-586 — AS discovery order for an issuer WITH a path: `/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server<path>`, then `/.well-known/openid-configuration<path>`, then `<path>/.well-known/openid-configuration`. #1 and #3 are 200 above; #2 404s but is never reached.
impact:
Spec §14 needs three edits, and one planned chunk of code gets deleted.

1. ADD A DEPENDENCY. `mcp` is not exported from `better-auth/plugins` in 1.7.5 — it lives in `@better-auth/mcp@1.7.5` (which pulls `@better-auth/oauth-provider@1.7.5`). Any spec line reading `import { mcp } from "better-auth/plugins"` will not compile. Same for `oauthProvider` and `cimd` (`@better-auth/cimd`). Pin all of them to 1.7.5 — they version-lockstep with core via peerDeps (`better-auth: ^1.7.5`, `better-call: 1.4.0`).

2. DELETE THE WILDCARD PRM ROUTE. The plugin already serves BOTH `/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource` and the path-inserted `/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mcp`, derived from the `resource` option's pathname (mcp/dist/index.mjs:192). MCPRouter writes zero PRM code; it only forwards `/.well-known/*` to `auth.handler`. That is one Hono line, not the 10-50 LOC fallback.

3. THE REAL GAP IS THE AS METADATA, NOT THE PRM. With the default `basePath: "/api/auth"`, `GET /.well-known/oauth-authorization-server` at the origin is a 404. It is served only at `/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server/api/auth` and `/api/auth/.well-known/openid-configuration`. That is RFC 8414-correct for issuer `https://host/api/auth`, and the pinned MCP SDK client follows it correctly (auth.js:552-586), so nothing is broken for SDK-based clients — but any spec assertion or smoke test that expects a 200 at the bare root path will fail. If MCPRouter wants the root path to work (hand-rolled clients, curl-based docs, older clients), set `basePath: "/"` — verified 200 at :4714 — or set `jwt({ jwt: { issuer } })`, which is the single knob that moves the issuer and every derived discovery path (oauth-provider authorize-riRRCSbC.mjs:5364).

DCR: nothing to change. It is off by default (`allowDynamicClientRegistration: false`, authorize-riRRCSbC.mjs:4207), the AS document omits `registration_endpoint` entirely, and `POST <basePath>/oauth2/register` returns 403 `{"error":"access_denied","error_description":"Client registration is disabled"}`. The spec's "asserted by a test" is achievable with the 3-line test above, and the negative control proves the test has teeth: flipping the flag produces `registration_endpoint` and turns the 403 into a 400. One spec correction: there is no `/mcp/register` route in 1.7.5 (404) — the DCR path is `<basePath>/oauth2/register`.
fallback_verified:
The named fallback (MCPRouter serving the path-inserted PRM from its own wildcard route) was not needed and was not built — the library already serves that path, proven by `GET /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mcp -> 200` with the correct `resource`. The fallback that IS still required is trivial and was exercised: forwarding `/.well-known/*` to `auth.handler` in Hono. Spike 1 proves the forwarding is load-bearing — `POST /oauth2/register` returned the Hono sentinel `hono-404-not-routed-to-better-auth` precisely because no route forwarded it, while every path that WAS forwarded got a real better-auth response.

The DCR negative control was run rather than assumed: a second instance with `allowDynamicClientRegistration: true, allowUnauthenticatedClientRegistration: true` produced `registration_endpoint = "http://localhost:4713/api/auth/oauth2/register"` and `POST .../oauth2/register -> 400 invalid_redirect_uri` (a validation error, i.e. the endpoint is live). So the "DCR is off" assertions are not vacuously true.
gotchas: MULTI-TENANT BLIND SPOT — the one place MCPRouter may still need its own route. The path-inserted PRM path is derived from the single configured `resource` string (mcp/dist/index.mjs:188,192). `GET /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/nope -> 404` (verified). If MCPRouter is a gateway serving per-tenant or per-upstream endpoints like `/mcp/:tenant`, only the one configured path answers, and every other tenant's client probe 404s. A gateway with one fixed `/mcp` endpoint is fine; a gateway with dynamic MCP paths needs its own PRM route after all. Decide this before implementation.

`resource` is validated at `betterAuth()` construction time and THROWS: https-only except localhost/[::1]/127.x loopback, no `?` query, no `#` fragment, no credentials (mcp/dist/index.mjs:14-27). A `?`-carrying resource is explicitly rejected with a message pointing you at `verifyAccessTokenRequest` + `createResourceServerChallenge` instead. This will bite in a staging env served over plain http on a non-loopback hostname.

`mcp()` IS the OAuth provider (it wraps `oauthProvider()` and spreads it — mcp/dist/index.mjs:172-177). It cannot be combined with a separate `oauthProvider()` plugin; the JSDoc says so at index.mjs:142-143. Anything the spec wanted from `oauthProvider` options gets passed through `mcp()`'s own options object.

PRM `authorization_servers` includes the basePath: `["http://localhost:4711/api/auth"]`, not the origin. That is correct and the MCP SDK handles it, but it means the issuer string carries `/api/auth` into every token `iss` claim and every discovery URL. Changing basePath later is a breaking change for issued tokens.

`mcp()` silently defaults `refreshTokenReuseInterval` to 30 seconds for all MCP clients (index.mjs:170), unlike bare `oauthProvider` which is strict. Set it to `0` to disable the rotation overlap window if the spec assumed strict single-use refresh tokens.

`/.well-known/openid-configuration` at the origin is a 404 with the default basePath; only `<basePath>/.well-known/openid-configuration` works. And the openid-configuration document is only served at all when `openid` is in the configured scopes (authorize-riRRCSbC.mjs:4239).

PRM correctly answers HEAD (200, empty body) and 405 with `Allow: GET, HEAD` on POST. Metadata responses carry `Cache-Control: public, max-age=15, stale-while-revalidate=15, stale-if-error=86400` — 15s, so a resource change propagates fast, but a CDN in front of MCPRouter will cache the PRM.

Test-harness detail, not a prod issue: `memoryAdapter({})` crashes at startup with `Error: Model oauthResource not found` because the oauth-provider's `init` seeds resources before any table exists. `memoryAdapter(new Proxy({}, { get: (t,k) => (t[k] ??= []) }))` fixes it. Worth knowing if MCPRouter's own tests want an in-memory better-auth.
There is no `/mcp/register` endpoint in 1.7.5 (404). If the spec or a client-compat note references it, it is stale. DCR, when enabled, is `<basePath>/oauth2/register`.

DCR has TWO independent gates, and the spec should name both: `allowDynamicClientRegistration` (off => 403 for everyone) and `allowUnauthenticatedClientRegistration` (off => a session or an authorized token is required even when DCR is on, authorize-riRRCSbC.mjs:1729). Asserting only the first leaves the second undefended if someone later enables DCR for first-party clients.
